jobs.title: Commission-Based Sales Agent (Software Products)
jobs.incentiveCompensation: Commission-only. No basic salary. Recurring commission on every client payment until the client goes live; fuel allowance on successful sales at company discretion.
jobs.description: Silver Fox Dynamics is expanding the reach of its software products across Pakistan and is registering sales agents across Pakistan, with a focus on Lahore, Islamabad, Karachi, Faisalabad and Multan. This is not an office job and it has no basic salary: you are rewarded purely on the business you bring in. You find the businesses, pitch our products, and stay with your client through to go-live. Every time your client pays, you earn your commission, and you can track it all from your own agent portal. Responsibilities. Identify and approach businesses in your city that can benefit from our software, such as restaurants, event venues, retailers, SMEs and enterprises needing ERP or custom systems. Introduce and pitch Silver Fox Dynamics products and services, and arrange demos or meetings with our team where needed. Register each of your clients in the agent portal and keep their details up to date. Follow up consistently and guide the client from first conversation through payment and go-live. Represent Silver Fox Dynamics honestly and professionally, with no false promises to clients. Track your clients and commissions in the portal and submit withdrawal requests when you are ready. Requirements. Based in, and familiar with the business market of, your city in Pakistan, especially Lahore, Islamabad, Karachi, Faisalabad or Multan. Confident communicator in Urdu and/or English (Punjabi or Sindhi is a plus) who can hold a convincing business conversation. Self-motivated and disciplined: you work without supervision and follow up without being chased. Your own transport, smartphone and internet access for field visits and the agent portal. Honesty and integrity in dealing with clients and with the company. Prior B2B, field-sales, IT or software-reselling experience is a plus; passionate beginners with a strong local network are welcome. Nice to have. An existing network of business owners, shop-owners, restaurateurs or venue managers. Experience selling software, IT services or other subscription products. Experience as a freelance or independent sales representative. What we offer. Commission-only earnings: no basic salary and no earnings cap. Recurring commission: whenever your client pays, you receive your commission, until the client is live. A personal agent portal where you can view your current commission, submit withdrawal requests and manage your clients. Fuel allowance on successful sales, provided at the company’s discretion once you have shown seriousness and results. Full commission terms are discussed with shortlisted agents before registration. Income depends entirely on your sales and is not guaranteed.

jobs.title: Junior Oracle APEX Developer
jobs.description: We are looking for a motivated Junior Oracle APEX Developer to work in Lahore. You will sit at our client's premises near Bahria Town, report to our head office in Islamabad, and work alongside our senior APEX developer on live client projects, learning how professional APEX applications are designed, built, tested and supported. Fresh graduates and developers with up to one year of experience are welcome. What matters most is your grip on database fundamentals and your appetite to learn quickly. Responsibilities. Build and modify APEX pages, forms, interactive reports and dashboards under the guidance of senior developers. Write and test SQL queries and PL/SQL procedures, functions and packages. Create and maintain database tables, views and sequences as per the design. Fix bugs, handle change requests and support testing and user acceptance. Prepare simple technical documentation and release notes. Follow team coding standards and take part in code reviews. Keep learning: APEX features, ORDS and REST services, and Oracle database best practice. Requirements. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field. Fresher or up to 1 year of experience (internships and training count). Good understanding of relational databases and strong basic SQL (joins, sub-queries, aggregation). Working knowledge of PL/SQL fundamentals. Basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Strong learning attitude, attention to detail and the ability to take feedback. Able to work on-site at a client's premises in Lahore (near Bahria Town); living nearby is preferred. Nice to have. Hands-on exposure to Oracle APEX through a course, internship, FYP or personal project. Oracle SQL or APEX training or certification. Familiarity with Git. What we offer. Salary: PKR 80,000 – 100,000 per month, based on skills and interview performance. Hands-on mentoring from senior Oracle APEX developers. Real client work from week one, with a clear path to a mid-level APEX role.

jobs.title: Senior Oracle APEX Developer
jobs.description: Silver Fox Dynamics builds ERP, SaaS and business-automation software for clients across industries, and Oracle APEX is at the heart of several of our production systems, including our cloud Restaurant ERP. We are hiring a Senior Oracle APEX Developer to take technical ownership of a long-term, client-based engagement in Lahore. You will sit at our client's premises near Bahria Town, Lahore, and report to our head office in Islamabad. This is a hands-on senior role. You will design the solution, build the hardest parts yourself, review the work of others, and be the person clients trust to get complex requirements delivered properly. Responsibilities. Design, build and maintain end-to-end Oracle APEX applications: interactive reports and grids, forms, dashboards, charts and approval workflows. Write, optimise and troubleshoot advanced SQL and PL/SQL (packages, procedures, functions, triggers, views) on Oracle Database. Model relational schemas and own data-integrity, indexing and performance decisions. Build and consume REST services with Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) and integrate third-party APIs and payment, messaging or accounting systems. Implement authentication, authorisation schemes and role-based access, and apply secure-coding practice (SQL injection, XSS, session handling). Translate client requirements into technical designs, estimates and delivery plans, and take part in client meetings, demos and UAT. Review code, set APEX and PL/SQL standards, and mentor junior developers. Manage environments and releases (development, testing, production) using version control and repeatable deployment practice. Provide go-live and post-launch support, and keep technical documentation current. Requirements. 9–10 years of hands-on professional experience building and delivering Oracle APEX applications to production. Strong command of SQL and PL/SQL, including query tuning with execution plans. Deep working knowledge of APEX: Page Designer, Interactive Grid / Report, Dynamic Actions, Universal Theme, template components, plug-ins and shared components. Practical experience with ORDS and REST web services (JSON). Solid JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS for customising APEX UI. Experience with Git or equivalent version control. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and clear written and spoken communication for client-facing work. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. Nice to have. Oracle Cloud / Autonomous Database experience. Oracle certifications (APEX Developer Professional, SQL / PL/SQL). BI Publisher or other PDF/report generation experience. Background in ERP, POS, inventory or finance applications. Experience leading or mentoring a small development team. What we offer. Salary: PKR 220,000 – 250,000 per month (gross), based on experience and interview performance. Long-term engagement on real client projects and live production systems. Technical ownership and a genuine voice in how we build. Based in Lahore, near Bahria Town, at the client's premises, reporting to our Islamabad head office. Candidates living near Bahria Town will be preferred.
